component.name: Dev Box
component.summary: Connect to your Microsoft Dev Box with Entra ID and FreeRDP

description.p: Lists your Microsoft Dev Boxes, starts and stops them, and connects to them with FreeRDP 3 — signed in with your organization's Entra ID account, with no tenant admin rights or app registration needed.

Device redirection (clipboard, drives, audio, USB passthrough, smart cards) is configurable per connection, and a built-in diagnostics log shows every HTTP call and the FreeRDP output when something fails. The Windows 365 web client is available as a fallback.
